title: Sickle Weapon Mod
description: This mod adds a new weapon: the sickle. It is a unique weapon crafted with 1 stick and 3 iron ingot. It works like a sword but does negative knockback, pulling your enemies instead of pushing them, very useful when chasing someone.
body:
Adds a new weapon called the Sickle, it works like an iron sword except for the fact that it pulls your target TO you instead of AWAY from you. It is crafted with 1x Stick and 3x Iron Ingot in the following configuration:
